//: Loaded when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Container (set by the Dockerfile). Ships with this host's non-Azure self-hosted deployment (issue #591) — see documentation/onboarding/18-self-hosted-docker.html for the full walkthrough.

Auth.//: SECURITY TRADE-OFF, not an oversight: a self-hosted deployment has no Entra tenant to sign into, so this defaults sign-in OFF for every request (see AuthBypassPolicy). Set both back to false and configure Microsoft Entra normally if this deployment needs real authentication, or put it behind a network boundary that enforces access instead (e.g. a private network, a reverse proxy requiring its own auth).

AgentFramework.//: Proven against OpenRouter in the M0 migration spike. ApiKey/Endpoint/DefaultDeployment come from environment variables only (see deploy/agenthub/.env.example) — never baked into this file.

Conversations.//: Relative to the app directory, not absolute — AppConfig:AI:Governance:DurableState:DatabasePath below has a security guard rejecting any path outside the app directory, so every persisted path here is kept consistently relative and gathered under one appdata/ folder for the compose volume to mount.

Observability.//: No collector runs in this compose file by default. Point at a sibling OTel collector by setting AppConfig__Observability__Exporters__Otlp__Enabled=true and __Endpoint to its address.
